policy: ecosys-ng is compiled, tested and benchmarked only with Zig 0.17.x.
Zig 0.16 is retired: a 0.16 build is not evidence for G1/G2 and may not be cited as current.
If only a 0.16 toolchain exists on the machine, install 0.17.x (prefer a repo-local tools/zig/) and record a blocker; never build with 0.16 instead.
Print `zig version` into every build/test receipt so the toolchain is recorded with the result.

caches_must_live_in_repo.flags_note: Zig 0.17: `zig build`/`zig test` accept --cache-dir but REJECT --global-cache-dir (measured 2026-10-12, audit/runs/zig017-pin017-debug-20261012). Set ZIG_GLOBAL_CACHE_DIR instead; the build runner passes --global-cache-dir to the compiler itself.

legacy_fortran.note: Unchanged by the Zig pin. The Zig 0.17 mandate applies to ecosys-ng only; legacy oracle builds keep their own recorded toolchain in audit/manifest/.

workspace_containment.rule: Every read, write, build, test, run, cache, checkpoint, download and log of this project stays inside the repository root (protocol.md §8a).
outside_access_allowed: reading the machine's installed toolchain and system libraries
